en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I said, ‘The Fasting-one, can he chew the gum?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who chews chewing gum when fasting.
He (the Imam) said, ‘No, he cannot do so.’”
